title: The Rooftop Reservation
video_prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action romantic comedy photographed on a 35 mm lens. A medium two-shot frames a woman in an emerald satin jacket on the left and a man in a cream dinner jacket on the right, standing just inside a rooftop conservatory. Wet glass, copper window frames, climbing jasmine and distant amber city lights fill the background. Their faces remain in the same plane and clearly visible. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. The woman initially holds a brass door handle, releases it, and raises an eyebrow; the man keeps his hands visible and answers her with an easy grin. The woman in the emerald satin jacket (S1) has this delivery: A bright adult female voice with a warm middle register, smiling skepticism, conversational contractions and quick, connected phrasing. The man in the cream dinner jacket (S2) has this delivery: A lightly raspy adult male voice with a warm middle-low register, playful confidence and quick, relaxed phrasing. From 0.65 to 2.05 seconds, the woman in the emerald satin jacket (S1) speaks with synchronized mouth movement. Amused disbelief; lift the pitch on “whole roof” and keep the question light. <d>[English] You booked the whole roof?</d> From 2.05 to 3.55 seconds, the man in the cream dinner jacket (S2) speaks with synchronized mouth movement. An immediate, dry answer through a small smile; lightly stress “without rain”. <d>[English] Just the bit without rain.</d> From 3.50 to 5.20 seconds, the woman in the emerald satin jacket (S1) speaks with synchronized mouth movement. Cut in with affectionate mockery, an audible smile and a falling, teasing finish. <d>[English] That's a very generous puddle.</d> From 5.20 to 6.85 seconds, the man in the cream dinner jacket (S2) speaks with synchronized mouth movement. Answer warmly, with quick confidence and a gentle invitation on “our table”. <d>[English] Come on, it's our table.</d> From 0.10 to 1.30 seconds, the door settles shut with one firm wooden closing thud. Each line answers the preceding one with immediate conversational intent; the listening faces react with their eyes and eyebrows. The man offers his arm; she accepts with a restrained smile, and both look toward a small linen-covered table. Their mouths settle naturally after the last reply.
